info.title: asdamir
info.description: Code generator and scaffolding tool for the Asdamir stack. Generates entity/DTO/repository/service/controller/test/migration sets that follow the framework's audited conventions out of the box.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: asdamir — scaffolding and code generation for Asdamir

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a new app / mobile / entity / page / module from a template.

commands.name: app
commands.description: Generate a standalone Asdamir app (Server + Gateway + tests + sln + demo DB) that consumes the framework via DI and is managed from AppManagement.

options.name: --output
options.description: Parent directory under which '<Name>/' will be created. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace. Defaults to the app name.

options.name: --local-feed
options.description: Absolute path to a local NuGet feed for locally-packed Asdamir.* packages.

options.name: --framework-version
options.description: Override the Asdamir.Core/Data/Web/Payments pin (single version for all). Defaults to the published baseline. Use with --local-feed to build against a locally-packed pre-release (e.g. the scaffold smoke).

options.name: --server-name
options.description: Blazor (Server) project name. Defaults to '<Name>.Server'. Prompted when omitted.

options.name: --api-name
options.description: REST API (Gateway) project name. Defaults to '<Name>.Gateway'. Prompted when omitted.

options.name: --database
options.description: SQL Server database name for this app's own (business) data. Defaults to the app name.

options.name: --db-server
options.description: SQL Server host (for the default connection string). Defaults to 'localhost'.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Full connection string override. A password-bearing string is NOT written to appsettings.json — a user-secrets command is printed instead.

options.name: --gateway-url
options.description: Base URL the Server uses to reach this app's Gateway. Defaults to 'https://localhost:7001/'.

options.name: --admin-email
options.description: Email of the app's starter admin (seeded into AsdamirVault scoped by AppId). Defaults to admin@<name>.local.

options.name: --admin-password
options.description: Password for the starter admin (only its PBKDF2 hash is seeded; the password is printed once). Defaults to a generated one.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Non-interactive: accept every default without prompting (CI).

options.name: --mode
options.description: 'commercial' (default) — identity/menus/permissions/localization/config live CENTRALLY in AsdamirVault and are managed from AppManagement. 'free' — self-contained: those management tables are emitted into the app's OWN database (single-tenant), so the app needs no AppManagement.

options.name: --billing
options.description: Opt-in: scaffold an end-user billing/payment page. Adds a Payment page (Server) plus the billing menu/permission/localization seeds. In commercial mode (Model A) the Gateway proxies gateway/billing/* → AppManagement and the billing data + Paddle secret live centrally in AsdamirVault; in free mode (Model B) the Gateway serves billing LOCALLY from the app's OWN DB via the Asdamir.Payments package (LocalDbBillingStore + payment rails + webhook). Default off: without it the app is unchanged.

options.name: --no-secrets
options.description: Skip auto-configuring the Gateway's dev user-secrets (CSPRNG Jwt:Key [free mode] + Security:EncryptionKey + ConnectionStrings:Default). By default `new app` writes them so the app is run-ready; pass this to manage secrets yourself.

options.name: --no-db
options.description: Skip creating the database + applying migrations. By default (when a SQL password was supplied) `new app` runs `db apply --create-database` so the app is ready to run; pass this to scaffold files only (offline / CI / review-first).

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase application name (e.g. GeneratedApp). Solution name + project-name prefix. Prompted when omitted. [default: ]

commands.name: mobile
commands.description: Generate a .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid app skeleton (Mobile + Mobile.Shared + Mobile.Data + tests).

options.name: --output
options.description: Parent directory under which '<Name>/' will be created. Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace. Defaults to the app name.

options.name: --gateway-url
options.description: Default Gateway base URL the app will hit. Burns into appsettings; can be overridden at runtime.

options.name: --local-feed
options.description: Optional absolute path to a local NuGet feed directory.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase application name (e.g. MobileV2). Becomes the solution + project name prefix.

commands.name: entity
commands.description: Generate a complete entity slice (POCO + DTO + repo + service + controller + tests + migration) and apply the migration.

options.name: --fields
options.description: Comma-separated 'Name:type' list. Types: string, int, long, bool, decimal, double, DateTime, Guid. Add '?' for nullable. Example: "Name:string,Email:string?,IsActive:bool".

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace for generated code. Defaults to the entity name.

options.name: --no-db
options.description: Generate files only — don't apply the migration. (By default `new entity` applies it via `db apply`.)

options.name: --apply
options.description: Deprecated (now the default): applying the migration is on by default. Pass --no-db to skip.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Full ADO.NET connection string for --apply. Takes precedence over --server/--database/--user/--password.

options.name: --server
options.description: SQL Server instance for --apply (when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --database
options.description: Target database for --apply (required when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --user
options.description: SQL login for --apply (SQL auth). Omit for Windows integrated auth.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user.

commands.name: page
commands.description: Generate a Blazor CRUD page (DataGrid + edit dialog + delete confirm) bound to an entity DTO.

options.name: --fields
options.description: Comma-separated 'Name:type' list — same syntax as `new entity`. Drives the grid columns and the edit form.

options.name: --route
options.description: Page route. Defaults to '/<plural-lowercase>'.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace for generated code. Defaults to the entity name.

options.name: --policy
options.description: Authorization policy applied to the page. Defaults to 'AdminAccess'.

options.name: --icon
options.description: Nav-menu icon for the generated menu row (seed_menu_<plural>.sql). Defaults to 'list'.

options.name: --no-db
options.description: Generate files only — in free mode, don't apply the menu/localization seed migrations. (By default they're applied via `db apply`.)

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase entity name (e.g. Customer). The page is named <Name>List.razor.

commands.name: feature
commands.description: Generate a full feature in one shot: entity (Gateway) + CRUD page (Server) + menu/permission seed.

options.name: --fields
options.description: Comma-separated 'Name:type' list — same syntax as `new entity`/`new page`.

options.name: --route
options.description: Page route. Defaults to '/<plural-lowercase>'.

options.name: --icon
options.description: Nav-menu icon for the generated menu row. Defaults to 'list'.

options.name: --policy
options.description: Authorization policy applied to the page. Defaults to 'AdminAccess'.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace override. Defaults to each project's namespace.

options.name: --output
options.description: App root (the nearest ancestor with a .sln is used). Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --gateway-dir
options.description: Override: the Gateway/API project directory (the entity is generated here).

options.name: --server-dir
options.description: Override: the Server/UI project directory (the page is generated here).

options.name: --no-db
options.description: Generate files only — don't apply the entity migration or free-mode seeds. (By default `new feature` applies them via `db apply`.)

options.name: --apply
options.description: Deprecated (now the default): applying is on by default. Pass --no-db to skip.

options.name: --connection
options.description: App-DB connection string for --apply (entity migration). Overrides --server/--database/etc.

options.name: --server
options.description: App-DB server for --apply.

options.name: --database
options.description: App-DB name for --apply.

options.name: --user
options.description: App-DB SQL login for --apply.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user.

options.name: --vault-connection
options.description: AsdamirVault connection string. When set with --apply, the menu/permission + localization seeds are applied to AsdamirVault too.

commands.name: module
commands.description: Generate a Core.* framework module skeleton (csproj + DI extension + abstraction + service + README).

options.name: --description
options.description: NuGet package description. Defaults to a placeholder you should edit before publishing.

options.name: --output
options.description: Parent directory under which '<Project>/' will be created. Defaults to the current working directory.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Module name. Either bare ('Telemetry') or fully qualified ('Core.Telemetry'). The 'Core.' prefix is added automatically.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Patch an existing scaffold — e.g. append a field to an entity slice.

commands.name: field
commands.description: Append one field to an existing entity scaffold (patches Entity.cs + Dto.cs, generates + applies a new ALTER TABLE migration, prints the snippets you still need to add by hand).

options.name: --field
options.description: Single 'Name:type' spec — same syntax as `new entity --fields`. Add '?' for nullable. Example: "Age:int" or "Note:string?".

options.name: --output
options.description: The app root OR the Gateway project. Defaults to the current directory (run from the app root).

options.name: --no-db
options.description: Generate the ALTER migration only — don't apply it. (By default `add field` applies it via `db apply`.)

arguments.name: ENTITY
arguments.description: PascalCase entity name that was previously created via `asdamir new entity`.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Remove a generated feature (entity + page + menu/permission). DESTRUCTIVE — asks before deleting.

options.name: --output
options.description: App root (nearest ancestor with a .sln). Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --gateway-dir
options.description: Override: the Gateway/API project directory.

options.name: --server-dir
options.description: Override: the Server/UI project directory.

options.name: --connection
options.description: App-DB connection string (to DROP the table + clean the migration journal).

options.name: --server
options.description: App-DB server (when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --database
options.description: App-DB name.

options.name: --user
options.description: App-DB SQL login.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user.

options.name: --vault-connection
options.description: AsdamirVault connection (to remove the menu/permission/grants).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation (for scripts). Default is to ask.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase entity name to roll back (e.g. Invoice).

commands.name: app
commands.description: Tear down a generated app — its directory + database + (commercial) AsdamirVault registration. DESTRUCTIVE — asks before deleting.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where the app lives: its parent dir OR the app dir itself. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --connection
options.description: App-DB connection string (its server is used to DROP the app database).

options.name: --server
options.description: App-DB server (when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --database
options.description: App database name to drop (defaults to the app name).

options.name: --user
options.description: SQL login.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user.

options.name: --vault-connection
options.description: AsdamirVault connection (commercial mode: purge the app registration + AppId-scoped data).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation (for scripts). Default is to ask.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: PascalCase app name to tear down (e.g. CustomerOrders).

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Static checks against the Asdamir audit pattern set.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Scan .cs files for Asdamir audit anti-patterns and report findings.

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory to scan recursively. Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --min-severity
options.description: Minimum severity to surface and to use for the exit code. One of: info, warning, error.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format. One of: text (default), json.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Also scan `tests/` and `test/` directories. Off by default — test infra uses patterns the rules flag.

commands.name: localization
commands.description: Cross-check used localization keys against the tree's seeds (AUD015).

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory to scan recursively. Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --min-severity
options.description: Minimum severity to surface and to use for the exit code. One of: info, warning, error.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format. One of: text (default), json.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Also scan `tests/` and `test/` directories. Off by default.

commands.name: permissions
commands.description: Cross-check Gateway policy `perm` requirements against the tree's seeds (AUD016).

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory to scan recursively. Repeatable — pass once per tree (e.g. src and db). Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format. One of: text (default), json.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Also scan `tests/` and `test/` directories. Off by default.

commands.name: db
commands.description: Database operations — create the catalog and apply *.sql migrations against SQL Server.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Create the database (optional) and apply *.sql migrations once each (journaled) against SQL Server.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Full ADO.NET connection string to the target database. Takes precedence over --server/--database/--user/--password.

options.name: --server
options.description: SQL Server instance (used when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --database
options.description: Target database name. Required when --connection is omitted; otherwise overrides the connection's Initial Catalog.

options.name: --user
options.description: SQL Server login (SQL auth — cross-platform). When omitted, Windows integrated auth is used.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user. Prefer passing the full --connection from a secret instead of this flag.

options.name: --migrations
options.description: Directory of *.sql migrations to apply in filename order.

options.name: --create-database
options.description: Create the target database (CREATE DATABASE) if it does not already exist, before applying migrations.

commands.name: localization
commands.description: Localization-completeness tooling — verify seeded keys against the live vault.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Diff the tree's seeded localization keys against the live vault (apply-drift).

options.name: --path
options.description: Directory whose SQL seeds define the expected (key,culture) pairs. Defaults to the current working directory.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Full ADO.NET connection string to the vault. Takes precedence over --server/--database/--user/--password.

options.name: --server
options.description: SQL Server instance (used when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --database
options.description: Vault database name (e.g. AsdamirVault). Required when --connection is omitted.

options.name: --user
options.description: SQL Server login (SQL auth). When omitted, Windows integrated auth is used.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user. Prefer a full --connection from a secret instead.

options.name: --app-code
options.description: The app's Code in dbo.Apps (e.g. Recon) — resolves its AppId. Provide this OR --app-id.

options.name: --app-id
options.description: The app's AppId (GUID) directly. Provide this OR --app-code.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format. One of: text (default), json.

commands.name: app
commands.description: Manage apps registered in a company's AppManagement DB (via the running AdminConsole.Api).

commands.name: register
commands.description: Register a managed app into a company's AppManagement DB via the running AdminConsole.Api.

options.name: --api
options.description: Base URL of the running AdminConsole.Api (e.g. https://localhost:5202/).

options.name: --token
options.description: SuperAdmin bearer JWT (from an authenticated AdminConsole session). Carries the company claim.

options.name: --code
options.description: App code — must equal the managed app's client_credentials ClientId.

options.name: --display-name
options.description: Human-readable app name.

options.name: --gateway-url
options.description: The app's Gateway base URL.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name (Production, Staging, …).

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: The client_credentials secret (min 20 chars). Encrypted at rest by the API.

commands.name: secrets
commands.description: At-rest encryption-key tooling (Security:EncryptionKey): re-encrypt stored secrets on key rotation, or produce an encrypted value.

commands.name: rotate-key
commands.description: Re-encrypt every at-rest secret in AsdamirVault from the OLD key to the NEW key (Apps.EncryptedClientSecret + AppConfigurations where IsEncrypted=1). Dry-run unless --apply.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Full ADO.NET connection string to AsdamirVault. Wins over --server/--database/--user/--password.

options.name: --server
options.description: SQL Server instance (when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --database
options.description: AsdamirVault database name (when --connection is omitted).

options.name: --user
options.description: SQL login (SQL auth). Omit for Windows integrated auth.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for --user.

options.name: --old-key
options.description: Current encryption key. Default: $ASDAMIR_OLD_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

options.name: --old-salt
options.description: Current encryption salt (if Security:EncryptionSalt is set). Default: $ASDAMIR_OLD_ENCRYPTION_SALT.

options.name: --new-key
options.description: New encryption key (≥32 chars). Default: $ASDAMIR_NEW_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

options.name: --new-salt
options.description: New encryption salt (if you use one). Default: $ASDAMIR_NEW_ENCRYPTION_SALT.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the re-encrypted values. Without it, runs a DRY-RUN (decrypt + re-encrypt + verify in memory, no writes).

commands.name: encrypt
commands.description: Encrypt a value with Security:EncryptionKey and print the v2 ciphertext — e.g. to seed an encrypted AppConfigurations value or a Companies connection string.

options.name: --value
options.description: Plaintext to encrypt. If omitted, read a single line from stdin.

options.name: --key
options.description: Encryption key (≥32 chars). Default: $ASDAMIR_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

options.name: --salt
options.description: Encryption salt (if you use Security:EncryptionSalt). Default: $ASDAMIR_ENCRYPTION_SALT.
